{
  "name": "loss_margin_ranking_exp_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from logsigmoid-margin losses to a margin-ranking loss weighted by an exponential advantage signal, emphasizing large advantage gaps while penalizing inversions.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = lpw - lpl; weighted_loss = weight * exp(-advantage_gap) * relu(margin_threshold - margin); loss = mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "relu",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "exponential_weighting"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "relu",
    "exp",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    margin_threshold = float(extra.get('margin_threshold', 0.1))\n    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    violation = ops.relu(ops.sub(margin_threshold, margin))\n    exp_weight = ops.exp(ops.neg(adv_gap))\n    loss = ops.mul(ops.mul(exp_weight, violation), weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_000_cost_sum",
  "intuition": "pairwise logsigmoid loss with sum aggregation instead of mean",
  "pseudocode": "loss = sum(-logsigmoid(clamp(alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap, -20, 20)) * weight)",

  ],

    ],

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return ops.sum(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_advantage_hinge_softplus",
  "intuition": "Use a hinge-style margin loss on advantage differences with a smooth softplus penalty to promote clearer preference separation while leveraging advantage signals directly.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = max(0, margin_value - advantage_gap * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l))\nloss = softplus(margin)\nfinal_loss = mean(weight * loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_hinge",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "softplus",

  },

  ],
  "implementation_hint": {

      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    margin_val = float(extra.get('margin', 1.0))\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)  # log_prob_w - log_prob_l\n    scoring = ops.mul(advantage_gap, diff)  # advantage_gap * (lpw - lpl)\n    margin = ops.relu(ops.sub(margin_val, scoring))  # max(0, margin_val - scoring)\n    loss = ops.softplus(margin)  # smooth approximation\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_rankgap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Apply a rank-based paradigm using tanh of advantage gap to softly encourage larger advantage differences, aggregating losses by sum to emphasize all pairs' rank consistency.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = batch['advantage_w'] - batch['advantage_l']\ntransformed = tanh(beta * adv_gap)\nloss = max(0, margin - transformed)\nweighted_loss = loss * weight\nfinal_loss = sum(weighted_loss) / sum(weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "sum_normalized",
    "constraint_family": "relu_margin"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "max",
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "sum",
    "div"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    beta = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 2.0))\n    margin = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin', 0.5))\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    transformed = ops.tanh(ops.mul(beta, adv_gap))\n    margin_tensor = ops.sub(margin, transformed)\n    loss = ops.max(margin_tensor, ops.zeros_like(margin_tensor))\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n        total_weight = ops.sum(weight)\n        loss_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)\n        return ops.div(loss_sum, total_weight + 1e-8)\n    else:\n        return ops.mean(loss)"
}
